scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across Microsoft Teams, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It can improve documentation accuracy in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on. With Prior Authorization Agent, healthcare get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.

The result? accelerate authorization processes, improve documentation accuracy, and better reduce care delays. Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
